name: SPT-CL J0040-4407 (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0040-4407, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: sptclj00404407-hubble
story: A vast gathering of galaxies, this massive cluster was detected by the South Pole Telescope through the Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect. Astronomers have weighed it by weak gravitational lensing.

claims.text: SPT-CL J0040-4407 is a massive galaxy cluster detected by the South Pole Telescope via the Sunyaev-Zeldovich effect
SPT-CL J0040-4407 lies at RA 10.2048, Dec -44.1329, matching this pointing
Its mass was studied by weak lensing
